0.description: Page background — near-white stock. Texture: fibres tile on the body background (scrolls), tooth + tone noise on body::before at --grain-opacity (fixed, multiply)

grain-opacity.description: The sheet's tooth and tonal unevenness (body::before, multiply). Fibres are authored at their own ink and do not scale with it.

dust-alpha.description: The ceiling for anything the pointer ride leaves in the air (graphite dust); raised from the hero exhaust's 0.16 because it has to read at pointer scale. Rubber on the sheet is bounded by the coverage cap instead.

400.description: Large metadata (>=18px) only — never small text (3.36:1 on paper)

500.description: Primary CTA fill, active state, annotations

700.description: Large amber accents only (2.87:1 on paper — not a focus ring)

text.description: Amber as small text on light surfaces (AA) and the focus ring (4.70:1)

etch-ink.description: Warm-neutral ink for type resting on glass (--etch-ink)

etch-shadow.description: Embossed light edge under etched type (--etch-shadow)

warm-glow.description: The single warm glow inside .glass / .cta--glass (radial, top-left)

paper.description: Everything on paper: headings, body, tiles, principles, labels, stickers, footer, case pages

glass.description: User revision: General Sans on glass as well as paper; only Caveat is used as the handwritten accent.

hand.description: The paper's handwriting only: annotation, sticky notes, Instax captions, hi! bubble, cursor label

pill.description: Tag chips only; CTAs are sharp (0)

media.description: Legacy — no longer applied to any surface

card.description: Legacy — no longer applied to any surface

sm.description: Every surface since 2026-09-04: glass slabs, workboard, case artboard, work tiles, art window, AI mock shells. Nested insets: 2px.

section-y.description: Single top separation between homepage sections; hardware padding is separate.

content-gap.description: Related text, section-header-to-content gap and card padding.

group-gap.description: Column groups and panel side padding.

grid-columns.description: 8 ≤900, 4 ≤640. The centred 1200px maximum container has 13/9/5 equally spaced dashed guides including its outer edges, without paired gutter lines. Desktop hero spans 8 + 4 columns; stacked scene spans centred 8/12, 6/8 or all 4 phone columns.

grid-gap.description: 20 ≤900, 16 ≤640. Shared horizontal gutter for hero, project, principle and AI grids; decorative guides use equal intervals without gutter pairs.

bolt-clearance.description: Minimum 16px clear space beyond every bolt footprint.

bolt-content-inset.description: 50px static content rail from the top and bottom frame edges.

bolted-panel-padding.description: Hero/contact rails include 32px for tilt and entrance motion.

bolted-board-padding.description: Workboard rails: 96px; bottom increases to 128px where magnetic hover applies.

motion._note: UI motion scale. Ambient loops and the SignalLoop scene are exempt. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration → 0.01ms at :root.

linger.description: How long rubber stays on the paper before its 3s fade (pointer ride). The marks layer is off under reduced motion, so this is not zeroed.

1.description: Micro: feedback, pointer tracking, lamp fills

2.description: Standard: hover lifts, shadows, small moves

1.description: Between siblings in one reveal group

surface-fx.description: Residue on the paper (pointer marks): above content, under the header

materials._note: Composite recipes, not single CSS vars — copy the CSS verbatim rather than trying to flatten into one token; these are the site's signature surfaces.

glass.description: White liquid glass — the .glass class, on the fixed nav and every content slab (hero, workboard, contact panel, case artboard). Whatever sits behind stays visible through an 8px blur — the paper grid must read through; one warm glow, a diagonal white sheen. Content slabs carry four black machined bolts (.bolt, 16px, 18px from each corner); the nav does not.
glass.css: background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255,255,255,.3), rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,.14) 75%), radial-gradient(120% 90% at 12% 0%, var(--glass-warm-glow), transparent 62%), rgba(255,255,255,.44); backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.5); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6), inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35), -8px -8px 20px -20px rgba(255,255,255,.55), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04), 14px 18px 36px -22px rgba(22,20,14,.16); border: .5px solid var(--line-1);

controls.description: One button family, three weights, on glass and paper alike (locked 2026-09-07). Every button is a die-cut sticker; weight is the stock alone.
controls.sticker-base: font: --font-paper 600 --text-small uppercase --track-label; padding: --space-3 --space-5; min-height: --space-7; border-radius: 0; rotate: -2deg (+1.5deg for a second sticker); box-shadow: --shadow-stuck; hover: rotate 0, translate 0 --lift-y, --shadow-lift; active: --shadow-press, flat

primary.use: the one primary action per view

text-link.underline: 2px var(--amber-700), offset 5px (3px pressed), ink on hover
text-link.use: tertiary: Read the case, All projects

typography._note: fontSize values are the implemented clamp() expressions (--text-* in global.css), not fixed px. Ceiling = desktop, floor = mobile.

label-eyebrow.description: --text-eyebrow: the one uppercase label style, on paper and glass.

_revision: 2026-09-06: user explicitly limited the system to two families: General Sans and Caveat.
